_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Denial band with unresolved ETF/stablecoin drag against BTC momentum; coil statistics and unconfirmed bottom analog make HOLD the graded call until flows align.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/Denial; narrative silent on phase/direction (commodity pipe story only)
next_move.confirmed_if: btc_momentum_30d rises above 60 and fear_greed above 40
next_move.invalidated_if: stablecoin_growth drops below 5 while etf_flows stay below 10
